# CAAIL: Cellular Agriculture AI Library

> A curated, openly-licensed library at the intersection of cellular agriculture and artificial intelligence: papers and preprints (an AI-method × research-area matrix), open-source software, databases, per-species datasets, talks, and field resources. A project of the Tufts University Center for Cellular Agriculture (TUCCA); content is MIT-licensed.

Status: beta. The inventory, topic tags and per-item metadata are solid, and each AI-method × research-area placement is a substantive claim about what the paper did. Placements are being re-verified against paper full texts and graded by evaluators, which tightens precision: where one is off it is typically a closely related cell rather than a paper that does not belong. Cite the paper itself.

This website is a navigation layer over canonical, human-readable Markdown in the GitHub repository (https://github.com/tucca-cellag/caail), which is the authoritative source for citation and full detail. The curated summaries on these pages are deliberately compressed; for substantive use, fetch the canonical source (a paper's DOI, a tool's linked repository, or the GitHub Markdown).

## Explore

- [Papers Explorer](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/papers/explorer/): interactive matrix of AI/ML methods × research areas, with per-reference DOI, code, and data links.
- [Citation Network](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/papers/network/): a shared-author co-authorship graph of the papers.
- [Software](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/software/): open-source tools grouped by application area.
- [Databases](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/databases/): query/lookup resources, repositories, atlases, ontologies, spectral libraries.
- [Datasets](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/datasets/readme/): train-on data artifacts organized by species, plus cross-species reference data and AI/ML benchmarks.
- [Talks & Videos](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/talks/): curated lectures, talks, and educational playlists.
- [By the Numbers](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/by-the-numbers/): library metrics, matrix coverage, and per-species dataset gaps.
- [Research Areas](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/research-areas/mediaoptimization/): deep-dive pages for the research-area axis: one per matrix column, plus metabolic modeling, which has a page without being a column. There is no index route; the sidebar and llms-full.txt carry the current set.
- [Methods](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/methods/benchmarksevaluation/): deep-dive pages for the AI/ML method axis, the matrix rows. Written one at a time, so most rows have no page and no `/methods/<row>/` route; that is expected, not a gap.

## About & contributing

- [About](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/about/): what CAAIL is and how it is organized.
- [Contributing](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/contributing/): how entries are categorized and added.
- [Other Resources](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/other-resources/): field overviews, courses, books, editorials, ecosystem initiatives, and curated bibliographies.

## Full text

- [Full canonical text](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/llms-full.txt): the entire library (papers, software, databases, per-species datasets, research areas, resources, and contributing guide) concatenated into one file, the authoritative full text behind these compressed summaries.

## Agent API

Static JSON, served by GET, with nothing to install or authenticate.

- [OpenAPI description](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/api/openapi.json): the shape of every endpoint below, generated from the schemas that validate them. Read this before guessing a key; the topic tree is under `tree` and the inverted index under `index`, not under top-level `themes` or `tags`.
- [Manifest](https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/api/index.json): corpus date, endpoint list, and counts labelled with the population each one counted. Fetch first.
- Endpoints: `matrix.json` (all method by area cells, empties included), `papers.json`, `catalog.json` (software and databases), `datasets.json` (curated `entries` plus the per-study `inventory` deposits), `topics.json`, `taxonomy.json`, all under https://tucca-cellag.github.io/caail/api/
- The same files are at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tucca-cellag/caail/main/site/public/api/, which some clients can reach when GitHub Pages is not allow-listed.

## Notes for AI agents

- Cite the canonical source, not these summaries: a paper's DOI, the linked code/data repository, or the canonical Markdown on GitHub.
- Core TUCCA members can access full paper text via the companion `caail` Zotero group library (members-only working library); external contributors suggest resources through the GitHub workflow in CONTRIBUTING.md.
